_comment: Traditional Chinese is the source language. Keys are the original zh-Hant strings used in index.html, app.js and the server; values are the English UI text. {name} placeholders are filled by the frontend; patterns handle server messages that embed numbers.

strings.Songferry · 把喜歡的歌帶走: Songferry · Take your playlists with you
strings.還沒有比對紀錄。貼上歌單連結開始第一次比對。紀錄保存在本機 .local 資料夾: No transfers yet. Paste a playlist link to start your first one. History is saved locally in the .local folder and survives restarts.
strings.Spotify 與 YouTube Music 歌單雙向轉移。: Move playlists between Spotify and YouTube Music, both ways.
strings.逐首找對版本，保留你熟悉的順序。: Pick the right version of every song and keep the order you know.
strings.一次設定，之後輕鬆轉移: Set up once, transfer any time
strings.讀取歌單，或確認後建立新的私人歌單。登入會保存在本機，重啟後仍有效。: Reads playlists, or creates a new private playlist after your review. The login is saved locally and survives restarts.
strings.讀取來源歌單，或建立新的私人歌單。: Reads the source playlist, or creates a new private playlist.
strings.建立 App，將 Redirect URI 設為：: and set its Redirect URI to:
strings.開發者需有 Premium；請把登入帳號加入 App 的測試使用者。新 App: The developer account needs Premium, and the account you sign in with must be added as a test user of the app. New apps can only read playlists you own or collaborate on.
strings.儲存並登入 Spotify ↗: Save and sign in to Spotify ↗
strings.先在 Spotify Developer Dashboard 建立 App，再將: Create an app in the Spotify Developer Dashboard first, then paste its Client ID here.
strings.，按 ⌘⌥I 打開開發者工具，切到 Network 並篩選: in Chrome, press ⌘⌥I to open DevTools, switch to Network and filter for
strings.。回到專案資料夾，雙擊：: . Back in the project folder, double-click:
strings.設定程式會讀取剪貼簿、驗證登入並保存到本機。顯示成功後重新整理此頁。請勿把複製的: The helper reads your clipboard, verifies the login and stores it locally, then clears the clipboard. Reload this page once it reports success. Never paste the copied text into a chat or share it.
strings.使用非 Google 官方的 ytmusicapi；服務變更時可能需更新套件或重: Uses the unofficial ytmusicapi library; if Google changes the service you may need to update it or sign in again.
strings.想帶走哪一份歌單？: Which playlist do you want to take with you?
strings.支援完整歌單連結。Podcast、本機音檔與無法讀取的歌曲會標記略過。: Paste a full playlist link. Podcasts, local files and unreadable songs are marked as skipped.
strings.將 YouTube Music 歌單轉入 Spotify。建立前需連接 Spot: Moves a YouTube Music playlist into Spotify. Connect Spotify and allow it to create private playlists before building.
strings.將 Spotify 歌單轉入 YouTube Music。: Moves a Spotify playlist into YouTube Music.
strings.每首預設選取第一個候選版本；沒有搜尋結果的歌曲才會略過。版本警示與分數保留供你確: The first candidate is selected for every song; only songs with no results are skipped. Version warnings and scores are shown so you can check them.
strings.只轉移歌曲資訊，不下載音樂。: Transfers song metadata only. No music is downloaded.
strings.已選擇 {selected} / {total} 首；略過的歌曲不會加入。保留原: {selected} of {total} selected; skipped songs are not added. Original order and duplicates are kept.
strings.歌名、歌手與長度比對相近；仍建議試聽確認。: Title, artist and length match closely; previewing is still recommended.
strings.尚未選擇版本，請確認候選歌曲或手動搜尋。: No version selected. Check the candidates or search manually.
strings.候選版本已更新，請選擇對應歌曲。: Candidates updated. Pick the matching song.
strings.沒有找到候選歌曲，試試其他歌名或歌手。: No candidates found. Try a different title or artist.
strings.歌單已建立，但部分歌曲尚未確認加入。: Playlist created, but some songs could not be confirmed.
strings.歌單已建立，歌曲順序已核對。: Playlist created and the song order was verified.
strings.歌單已建立，請在 {destination} 確認歌曲內容。: Playlist created. Please check its contents in {destination}.
strings.歌單已建立，但未能完整核對內容，請開啟歌單檢查。: Playlist created, but its contents could not be fully verified. Please open it and check.
strings.此工作已送出建立要求但結果未確認，請到 {destination} 檢查是否已有: A create request was sent for this job but the result is unconfirmed. Check {destination} for the playlist.
strings.{error} 請貼上來源連結重新讀取歌單。: {error} Paste the source link to load the playlist again.
strings.刪除紀錄（不會刪除已建立的歌單）: Delete entry (created playlists are not affected)
strings.目前有工作正在進行，完成後再開始新的比對。: A job is still running. Start a new transfer once it finishes.
strings.請先在 Spotify Developer Dashboard 建立 App，將: Create an app in the Spotify Developer Dashboard, add the Redirect URI above to it, then paste the Client ID.
strings.Client ID 應為 32 位十六進位字元，請從 Spotify App 設: The Client ID should be 32 hexadecimal characters. Copy the full Client ID from your Spotify app settings.
strings.正在前往 Spotify，授權讀取與建立私人歌單…: Going to Spotify to allow reading and creating private playlists…
strings.正在前往 Spotify 登入並授權讀取歌單…: Going to Spotify to sign in and allow reading playlists…
strings.已登出 Spotify，本機保存的登入資訊已刪除。: Signed out of Spotify. The locally saved login has been deleted.
strings.正在讀取歌單並逐首搜尋，較長的歌單需要幾分鐘。: Loading the playlist and searching song by song. Long playlists take a few minutes.
strings.建立成功，但未能完整核對內容，請開啟歌單檢查。: Created, but the contents could not be fully verified. Please open the playlist and check.
strings.登入檔已設定 · 建立時驗證: Login file set · verified when creating
strings.已取消 Spotify 登入，可再次按「連接 Spotify」。: Spotify sign-in was cancelled. You can click "Connect Spotify" again.
strings.{error} 請確認本機程式正在執行，再重新整理頁面。: {error} Make sure the local server is running, then reload the page.
strings.Spotify Client ID 應為 32 位英數字元。: The Spotify Client ID should be 32 alphanumeric characters.
strings.Spotify 拒絕請求。請確認授權範圍、Premium 與 App 測試使用者: Spotify refused the request. Check the granted scopes, Premium, and the app's test users; source playlists must be yours or collaborative.
strings.Spotify 登入交換失敗，請確認 Redirect URI 設定。: Spotify sign-in failed. Check the Redirect URI setting.
strings.Spotify 登入已失效，請重新連接 Spotify。: The Spotify login has expired. Please reconnect Spotify.
strings.Spotify 登入已失效，請重新連接。: The Spotify login has expired. Please reconnect.
strings.YouTube Music 未回傳有效歌單 ID。請先檢查帳號中的歌單，避免重複: YouTube Music did not return a valid playlist ID. Check your account before trying again to avoid duplicates.
strings.尚未設定 Spotify Client ID，請先完成下方的首次連接設定。: No Spotify Client ID yet. Complete the first-time setup below.
strings.工作仍在進行中，請等待完成後再刪除。: The job is still running. Wait for it to finish before deleting.
strings.工作階段已更新，請重新整理頁面: The session has changed. Please reload the page.
strings.已有歌單正在比對，請等待完成。: Another playlist is being matched. Please wait for it to finish.
strings.所選歌曲不在比對結果中。: The selected song is not among the candidates.
strings.找不到工作。伺服器重啟後需重新讀取歌單。: Job not found. After a server restart the playlist must be loaded again.
strings.搜尋失敗，可稍後使用手動搜尋重試: Search failed. Try a manual search later.
strings.服務連線失敗，請檢查網路與帳號設定後重試。: Could not reach the service. Check your network and account settings, then try again.
strings.本機音檔、Podcast 或無法讀取的歌曲，已略過: Local file, podcast or unreadable item, skipped
strings.此工作已送出建立要求。請先到 YouTube Music 檢查結果，避免重複建立: A create request was already sent for this job. Check YouTube Music first to avoid duplicates.
strings.比對在伺服器重啟時中斷，請重新讀取歌單。: Matching was interrupted by a server restart. Please load the playlist again.
strings.無法讀取、已下架或非歌曲項目，已略過: Unreadable, removed or non-song item, skipped
strings.登入要求已失效，請回首頁重新連接。: The sign-in request has expired. Go back to the home page and connect again.
strings.請先依 README 設定 YouTube Music 的 browser.js: Set up the YouTube Music browser.json as described in the README, then reload.
strings.請先等待比對完成。: Please wait for matching to finish.
strings.請先連接 Spotify，才能搜尋對應歌曲。: Connect Spotify first so matching songs can be searched.
strings.請輸入目標歌單名稱。: Enter a name for the new playlist.
strings.請重新連接 Spotify，授權建立私人歌單後再試。: Reconnect Spotify and allow creating private playlists, then try again.
strings.連線或服務發生錯誤，請檢查設定後重試。: A connection or service error occurred. Check your settings and try again.
strings.長度差超過 15 秒: length differs by more than 15 s
strings.Spotify 未回傳有效歌單 ID，請先到 Spotify 檢查建立結果。: Spotify did not return a valid playlist ID. Check Spotify for the result.
strings.Spotify 沒有確認新增結果。: Spotify did not confirm the addition.
strings.請貼上完整的 YouTube Music 歌單連結，例如 https://mus: Paste a full YouTube Music playlist link, e.g. https://music.youtube.com/playlist?list=…
strings.連結缺少有效的 list 歌單 ID。: The link has no valid list playlist ID.
strings.部分歌曲未確認加入，請開啟 Spotify 歌單檢查；工具不會自動重送。: Some songs could not be confirmed. Open the Spotify playlist to check; nothing is resent automatically.
strings.比對完成。已選 {selected} 首，略過 {skipped} 首。 請按「: Matching finished. {selected} selected, {skipped} skipped. Click "Allow Spotify to create playlists" and you can build it.

patterns: ^Spotify 請求過多，請稍後重試（Retry-After: (.+) 秒）。$
Too many Spotify requests. Retry after $1 seconds.
^建立結果未確認。請先到 (.+) 查看是否已有歌單；此工作不會自動重試，以免重複建立。$
The result is unconfirmed. Check $1 for the playlist first; this job will not retry, to avoid duplicates.
^YouTube Music 標示 (\d+) 首，但只讀到 (\d+) 首。請改用一般歌單或稍後重試，以免轉移不完整。$
YouTube Music reports $1 songs but only $2 could be read. Use a regular playlist or retry later to avoid an incomplete transfer.
